binary_diff.scope: Binary diff against actual main PRG; no code, timing, frequency, PCM or envelope bytes changed.

method: Two actual VICE runs of byte-identical instruction streams, banks and sample score; only ordinary-voice control fields differ. Diagnostic control0x19 holds those two triangle outputs at known constant phase with TEST while preserving gate/envelope. Both raw recordings use their identical first latch cycle and identical crop frames. Means removed independently; numerical SID component is main minus PCM-only. No gain, EQ, filtering, correlation alignment or derived listening file.
limits: Subtraction is an analysis of emulator mixer components, not a third hardware recording. It assumes the unfiltered fixed-master-volume mixer is approximately additive; output integer rounding and external-filter state can leave a small residual. Peak headroom and identical native bus timing are checked, but no physical SID balance or perceptual approval is established.
